data.name: Affaf
data.gender_notes: Affaf is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Affaf is derived from the Arabic word 'iffah', meaning chastity, virtue, and modesty. It signifies a person of high moral character. The name Affaf carries the meaning “Chastity, Virtue, Modesty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Affaf usually hope their child will grow to embody chastity, virtue, modesty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The Quran emphasizes the importance of 'iffah in several verses, including Surah An-Nur, where it is associated with purity and righteousness.
data.etymology: Affaf belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Chastity, Virtue, Modesty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Affaf total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_arabic.name: عَفاف
in_arabic.long_meaning: عَفاف هو اسم يعني الوفاء بالعهد والإحسان والإستقامة والمثابرة. ويُعتبر من أسماء الخيرات في الإسلام، وقد ذكره الله تعالى في القرآن الكريم. ويدل على الفرد الذي يوفى بالعهده، ويحافظ على الوعد، ويستقيم في دین الله، ويُثاب على السلوك الخيري. ويُعتبر اسم عَفاف من أسماء الإسلام، وقد سُمي به العديد من الصحابة والتابعين، ويعتبر من أسماء النبي محمد ﷺ، ويدل على الشخصية النبيلة التي يمتلكها المسلم المحتسب.

in_urdu.name: عَفاف
